Source Notes:
Due to a power issue, the original source was missing about 4 minutes of audio.  Thanks to Henry Hart, all was not lost.  This gap was patched with audio from a pair of DPA 4061s on the same stand/location.  The DPA source was patched in from 3:04 in Grace is Gone to 0:10 into Funny the Way It Is.
